capabilities: create compressed vault backups as .tar.zst archives
generate SHA-256 sidecar checksum files and validate archives before restoring
extract restore snapshots into a separate timestamped folder without overwriting the live vault
prune old backups with a configurable maximum count
extras: Restores extract to a separate recovery directory for review rather than overwriting the vault; archives always exclude .obsidian and .trash. Restores are manual only — no scheduled automatic backups are described.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to make verified, storage-efficient local vault backups with safe restoration.
summary: Vault backup plugin that creates tar archives compressed with Zstandard, verifies them with SHA-256 checksums, and restores snapshots non-destructively.
